candidates: When adding links to external documentation in the Vitest addon docs, verify the URL by navigating to the actual page rather than constructing a plausible-sounding path. Vitest documentation uses anchor fragments on single canonical pages (e.g., `https://vitest.dev/config/#isolate`, `https://vitest.dev/guide/improving-performance#sharding`) — not per-option HTML sub-pages like `/config/isolate.html#isolate`.
